title: Direct answer without tools
prompt: Return exactly this JSON object and nothing else: {"answer":"quartz"}. Do not call any tools.

title: Workspace research across two documents
prompt: Read README.md and docs/why-neoagent.md from the current workspace. Return JSON with keys "sources" and "comparison". The "sources" array must contain both exact file paths, and "comparison" must be a short sentence about how NeoAgent differs from Hermes.

title: Artifact-producing workspace task
prompt: Create a Markdown report file in the workspace that lists three concrete differences between NeoAgent and Hermes from docs/why-neoagent.md. Mention the output file path in the final response.

title: Integration status summary
prompt: Inspect the configured integration providers available in this NeoAgent app and return a JSON object with one key named "summary" containing a short sentence.

title: Scheduled task planning
prompt: Create a task named "Benchmark heartbeat" with a manual trigger, then explain in one sentence what it would do when run.

title: Temporal memory correction response
prompt: Answer in one sentence: if a user's previous fact becomes outdated, how should NeoAgent memory treat the newer fact relative to the older one?

title: Failure recovery explanation
prompt: In one sentence, explain how NeoAgent should react when a tool fails in the middle of a larger task.
